text:
Maya (Docs): Quick heads up — I'm assembling the release notes for v2.14.0, target change window tonight 22:00 UTC. Draft below, need a fast pass on rollback wording, deploybot command, and region windows.
Sam (Eng): I pasted a short draft to the docs repo: https://git.internal/redwood/release-notes/v2.14.0.md. Main infra notes: canary then full rollout. Rollback plan: revert model pin to r2.13.7 and scale back dedicated pool.
Jules (Product): Nice. Please add a one-line blurb for Dedicated customers about the new batching config. Also call out the metrics to watch (p95 latency, error-rate).
Maya (Docs): Added the Dedicated blurb and metric bullets. Draft excerpt: "Improves throughput via adaptive batching; monitor p95 and 5xx rate during rollout." Thoughts?
Lee (Runtime): Suggest we include explicit thresholds: p95 > 500ms for 5min OR error-rate > 0.5% => automatic rollback. That maps to the deploybot policy we discussed.
Sam (Eng): Agreed. I can map those to the deploybot flags. Example command we plan to issue:
```
/deploy rollout v2.14.0 --canary=10% --metric-p95=500ms --metric-errors-5m=0.5% --watch=15m
```
ops-oncall: Confirming EU region is available for the 22:00 UTC window. I'll be oncall coverage and can manually trigger the rollback if the deploybot health check flags it.
deploy-bot: job queued by @sam — rollout v2.14.0 (canary 10%). Watchers: ops-oncall, Sam (Eng).
Jules (Product): One more: add a short internal note for comms that the release updates the quantization defaults; include a short 'what to test' checklist for QA.
Maya (Docs): Added QA checklist: 1) smoke gen in staging w/ long context 2) embedding regression quick-sample 3) latency profile at 512 tokens.
Lee (Runtime): For rollback automation, recommend adding a pin-exec step to restore production model tag: `modelctl set-active r2.13.7`. Put that exact command in the runbook.
Sam (Eng): Added runbook snippet and the modelctl command. Also aligning deploybot to send an alert to #incidents if rollback triggers.
ops-oncall: Will monitor. ETA to lock release notes and post internal announcement: 21:30 UTC?
Maya (Docs): 21:30 works. I'll lock the PR and post the internal announcement once deploybot job is kicked.
Jules (Product): :thumbsup: Thanks everyone. Minimal copy tweak: change "improves throughput" -> "reduces tail latency while improving throughput".
Maya (Docs): Done. Final check: Sam, Lee, ops-oncall — can you reply with :+1: if we are green to proceed?
Sam (Eng): +1
Lee (Runtime): +1
ops-oncall: +1 — will be available at the window.
Maya (Docs): Great — locking notes and will post to #eng-releases and company internal at 21:30 UTC. Deploybot will run at 22:00 UTC.
deploy-bot: scheduled: rollout v2.14.0 at 22:00 UTC — canary 10% — watchers: ops-oncall, Sam (Eng).
Maya (Docs): Thanks all. If anything changes before 21:30 ping me here.
